sentences.text:
===
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Vibhuti Ranjan Sonvadra
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Smt. Nirmala Kumari
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar
 Jha
 Oral Order

The petitioner seeks bail in Ram Krishna Nagar P.S. case No. 127 of 2012 under Section 341, 323,
353, 427, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 62, 63, 31 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
The informant alleged that he raided M/s New Ganga Sagar Sweets of Pawan Kumar situated in Khemnichak, Patna but owner of the shop did not show any license.
It is alleged that during the course of raid petitioner and others came, assaulted the raiding party and torn documents.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner was granted anticipatory bail vide order dated 10.12.2013 passed in Cr. Misc. No. 20656 of 2013 but the petitioner did not surrender in court.
The petitioner is in jail since 15.04.2017.
